remarks: Enjoy comfort, convenience, and security at the highly desirable Mill River House. This rarely available 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo features an open layout with high ceilings and large windows overlooking the courtyard, filling the space with natural light. Large storage space transfers with the unit.  The modern kitchen offers granite countertops and a center island, while a private balcony-accessible from both the living room and primary bedroom-provides relaxing views. The primary suite includes a spacious walk-in closet and an en-suite bath, while the second bedroom also features a walk-in closet and nearby full bath.  Additional highlights include central air, natural gas heat, and in-unit laundry. Residents enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, clubhouse, landscaped garden with grills, and secure garage parking. This doorman, pet-friendly elevator building sits next to Mill River Park, offering year-round events, trails, a carousel, and seasonal ice skating.
